People, addressed at the opening of the verse.
You are, in the condition “if you are in doubt.”
Doubt concerning resurrection.
Resurrection after death.
We created you, introducing the stages of human creation.
Dust, to which the beginning of human creation is ascribed.
A drop of reproductive fluid in the sequence of creation.
A clinging substance, a stage in the sequence of embryonic creation.
A morsel of flesh resembling a chewed piece, describing an embryonic stage.
Formed, describing the developing morsel of flesh.
And other than; with mukhallaqah, “unformed.”
Formed; preceded by ghayr, “unformed,” contrasted with formed.
To make clear to you, expressing the purpose of describing creation.
And We establish and retain, concerning what remains in wombs.
Wombs, where the unborn develop in their mothers’ bodies.
We will, concerning what is retained in wombs by divine will.
A term or endpoint for remaining in the womb.
Named or appointed, describing the term for remaining in the womb.
We bring you forth, from the womb into life after birth.
As children, describing the state in which humans emerge from the womb.
That you may reach your stage of full strength and maturity.
Your full strength and maturity.
Whose life is taken, referring to one whose death arrives.
Is returned, to the most diminished stage of life.
The most diminished, describing a stage of life with loss of knowledge.
Life or lifespan, the duration and stages of human living.
Know, in the negation of knowing after prior knowledge.
After, marking the relation to earlier knowledge.
Knowledge the person previously possessed.
Anything, within the negated phrase “know nothing.”

The earth, the ground of growth, initially described as inactive.
Inactive and dry, describing the earth before water arrives.
We sent down, referring to rainwater upon the earth.
Water, which brings movement and growth to the earth in this depiction.
It stirred, describing the earth’s response to water.

And it produced, referring to the emergence of kinds of vegetation.
Every, expressing the range and diversity of vegetation.
A kind or category of vegetation, in “every beautiful, fresh kind.”
Created, referring to the heavens and the earth.
The heavens, part of the creation mentioned in the verse’s question.

Firm mountains, stable and established elevations in the earth.

Every, expressing the diversity of what grows.

evidence.use: Official QAC and local QAC0.4 confirm three occurrences:bahij in22:5 and50:7,bahjah in27:60. All assigned lexical positions checked against exact QAC roots.

Primary Taj confirms Nabighah pearl-diver witness with conditional yuhilla wa-yasjudi;corrected supplied indicative endings. Bahij describes the diver rather than the pearl. Abu Dhuayb witness is an invocation of rain for Umm Amr;retained its supplied li-ma variant and qualification of uncertain pre-Quranic date. Anonymous meadow fragment not assigned a poet or date.
Primary Tabari supports plant kind and beauty in min kulli zawjin bahij;did not reduce zawj to a mandatory male/female pair or bahij to green,flowering,or psychologically happy.
Primary Tabari supports beautiful gardens and the theological question distinct from lexical definition. Adl interpretations include setting up equals and turning from truth.
